title: Investing in Temple TX from Out of State: Why This Market (Part 1 of 5)
description:
Thinking about investing in Temple, Texas from out of state? This is Part 1 of my 5-part complete guide to buying rental property in Temple remotely. In this video, I break down exactly why Temple TX belongs in your investment portfolio — the economic drivers, the numbers, and why the buying window is open right now.

📊 KEY NUMBERS COVERED IN THIS VIDEO:
- Median home price: $255,000 (vs $550,000+ in Austin)
- Typical 3BR/2BA rental rate: $1,500–$1,750/month
- Average cap rate: 6–8% (vs ~5% in Dallas/San Antonio)
- Property tax rate: ~2.2%
- Bell County occupancy rate: 92%+
- No state income tax in Texas

🏥 WHY TEMPLE'S ECONOMY IS RECESSION-PROOF:
Baylor Scott & White Medical Center in Temple is the 11th largest hospital in Texas with 8,000+ employees. Fort Cavazos (Fort Hood) is one of the largest military bases in the world. These two institutions create a constant pipeline of quality tenants — travel nurses, healthcare professionals, and military families.
